summary: Expands track-map pixel rows: reads a per-pixel fill width and a row-repeat count from a secondary structure, stretches each source byte into a repeated 4-byte pattern filled for the pixel width, then duplicates each row downwards via F_2DArrayBlockCopy for vertical expansion. Iterates a1[68] rows, each a1[23] bytes wide.

operations.description: v4 = *a4: load the destination row-pointer array base.
v6 = *(a2 + 4) + a1[103]: form a secondary structure pointer by adding the self field at +0x19C to the pointer stored at a2+4.
Read two control bytes from the secondary structure: v21 = byte at v6+140 (per-pixel fill width in bytes) and v18 = byte at v6+150 (row-repeat count). Save v16 = *a4 as the restore value for dstBase.
Outer loop over rows: iterate while rowIndex v9 < a1[68] (row count from self field at +0x110); advance rowIndex by rowRepeatCount each pass.
Per row: v10 = *a3 (source pixel row string); v11 = row pointer from the destination array v4[4 * v9]; v12 = v11 + a1[23] sets the row-end cursor using the self field at +0x5C as pitch.
Inner loop over the current row: while the destination pixel cursor v19 is below the row end v12, consume the next source byte v13 = *v10++.
If v21 > 0, expand the current source pixel; otherwise skip expansion (v19 is not advanced and the loop condition is unaffected).

Expand pixel value v13 into the repeated 4-byte pattern v14 = (v13<<8 | v13) << 16 | (v13<<8 | v13); fill v21 bytes at v19 with memset32 for the aligned part plus memset for the trailing v21 & 3 bytes; advance v19 += v21 and restore v4 = v16.
After the inner loop, if v18 > 1, duplicate the finished row downwards by the remaining v18-1 copies.
F_2DArrayBlockCopy(v4, v9, v4, v9 + 1, v18 - 1, a1[23]): copy a block v18-1 rows tall and a1[23] bytes wide from source row v9 to row v9+1 onward, producing the vertical expansion.
Advance to the next source row: v9 += v18 and ++a3; preserve v18 as the returned pointer value.
Return the row-repeat/result pointer (v18, or the last F_2DArrayBlockCopy result).

clean_pseudocode: F_2DArrayBlockCopy(dstBase, rowIndex, dstBase, rowIndex + 1, rowRepeatCount - 1, self[23]);
unresolved: The object type behind a2+4 and the meaning of the control bytes at v6+140 / v6+150 are unnamed; they gate per-pixel fill width and row-repeat count but their source class is unknown.
memset32 and memset are treated as compiler intrinsics, not listed callees; the packet records only F_2DArrayBlockCopy as a call target.
When v21 == 0 the inner loop never advances v19, so per-source-byte consumption and the v19 < v12 bound could diverge; the decompiled control flow does not resolve this case.
Whether self fields +0x5C (pitch) and +0x110 (row count) belong to the same object as the secondary structure at a2+4 is not established.
